## Suggestion

What would help teachers or learners? Please use fictional examples and omit student names, photos, and personal information.

## Context

If useful, share the approximate age range, team size, session length, and paper or projector plan. Do not identify individual students.

## Proposed change

How would the change support the learning goals? For a classroom report, distinguish observations from measured results.
